messages.subject: Dynamic forms issue
parts:
Well hi there.I'm so confused trying to implement the following:
i want to have a form that initially shows a question from a db table, while in the bottom of this form there are radiobuttons with labels option1,option2 and a submit button.So, when a user chooses option1 another question is reactively presented in the same form. Two problems so far:
1)how can i "hide" the first question that initially is presented and be replaced by the next questions
2)when the user gets the new questions the radiobuttons should be reactively some kind of reseted.

*lets say more clear: we must have a form that is reactively re-produced exactly how it was and reseted to selected=false.
Any ideas of how that could be solved?i think that this issue will solve a lot of things for building dynamic forms->dynamic reports...

On Fri, Jun 7, 2013 at 5:28 AM, stratos mos <soj...@gmail.com> wrote:
> 1)how can i "hide" the first question that initially is presented and be
> replaced by the next questions

There are two options here: You can either use dynamic UI to replace
the item, or you can use conditionalPanel to hide the item.

For an example of dynamic UI, see here:
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/dynamic_ui/

For an example of conditionalPanel, see the example on the main Shiny
page. If you check "Show density estimate", a slider appears at the
bottom:
http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/

> 2)when the user gets the new questions the radiobuttons should be reactively
> some kind of reseted.

In the new (0.6.0) version of Shiny, you can set the value of
radioButtons with updateRadioButtons(). The help page for that
function has an example of how to use it.


-Winston
